roadmap.goal: Fix the pi-kata live phase-recording gap: deliver the crafter skill via the missing resources_discover handler so the model receives the des-log-phase recording contract, wire advance_step_id for deterministic per-step ids, and add model-free regression tests covering the previously-uncovered live wiring (skill discoverability + extension-driven recording + incomplete-cycle-blocks-at-commit). Zero src/des change.

steps.name: Deliver crafter skill via resources_discover handler
steps.scenario_name: Bug regression: the rendered pi extension surfaces the crafter skill via resources_discover
criteria: Add a regression test (RED) asserting the rendered extension registers a resources_discover handler returning skillPaths that includes the installed software-crafter skill dir
Implement resources_discover in the template returning the placed skill dir in skillPaths (confirm shape vs pi 0.79.9 types.d.ts ResourcesDiscoverResult)
PiDESPlugin.verify asserts the extension exposes resources_discover AND the skill dir is discoverable (not just file-exists)
Extension stays a pure relay (thin-translator AST/string test still green); zero src/des change
steps.implementation_notes: Root Cause A: the skill (des-log-phase recording contract) is never surfaced to pi because the extension has no resources_discover handler. Reuse the rendered software-crafter skill dir the plugin already places.

steps.name: Extension-driven recording regression + deterministic step-id advance
steps.scenario_name: Bug regression: a kata cycle recorded via the skill-prescribed path populates the execution log and an incomplete cycle blocks at commit
criteria: Add a model-free regression test (RED) that drives RED-GREEN-COMMIT recording via the skill-prescribed des-log-phase invocation path (install-resolved spawn) rather than a direct Python record_phase shortcut, asserting events land in execution-log.json
Assert an incomplete cycle BLOCKS at the live commit boundary; if it fail-opens (the dogfood symptom) and that is engine behavior, STOP and escalate (K2 zero-engine-change boundary)
Wire advance_step_id deterministically (extension/skill calls it for a fresh NN-NN per RED) instead of dead code; or document removal if prose-increment is retained
Zero src/des change; pi_kata + pi_harness suites stay green
steps.implementation_notes: Root Cause B + the confirmed second defect (commit allowed despite missing phases WITH /kata run). Replace kata_support.record_phase direct shortcut for >=1 scenario with extension-path-driven recording so the live wiring is covered. advance_step_id is currently dead code.
